codes.description: A helper tool or platform SSH client is being used as the primary tunnel/data plane instead of a weaverssh endpoint adapter.
codes.developer_action: Update guard tests and tunnel policy if a new adapter is added.
kb_titles: External tool adapter attempted to replace weaverssh data plane
codes.operator_action: Reject the plan; reframe the tool as loopback adapter/probe terminating at wv endpoint.
codes.title: External adapter attempted to own data plane
codes.verification: Tunnel-policy guard passes and adapter plan shows data_plane_owner=weaverssh.

codes.description: A runtime cryptographic proof required for relay/transfer/service activation was missing or failed verification.
codes.developer_action: Return structured verifier reason without leaking secret material.
kb_titles: Runtime cryptographic proof failed
codes.operator_action: Generate fresh proof with correct capability and chain binding; fail closed if not possible.
codes.title: Authproof missing or invalid
codes.verification: Accepted proof includes required capability and relay starts only after verification.

codes.description: The planned authority source is controllable by root on the remote host, so it cannot enforce remote-root-resistant policy.
codes.developer_action: Model and runtime must fail closed for strict remote-root-resistant claims.
kb_titles: Runtime cryptographic proof failed
codes.operator_action: Move authority to workstation/peer outside remote-root authority or lower expectations explicitly for non-strict testing.
codes.title: Authority material is in remote-root domain
codes.verification: Policy report shows authority_outside_remote_root=true before activation.

codes.description: wv could not determine an active SSH connection profile or required profile fields.
codes.developer_action: Make profile lookup error include searched paths and selected setup source.
kb_titles: Connection profile is missing or inactive
codes.operator_action: Run wv connection list/current, create or select a profile, then retry.
codes.related_commands: wv connection list | wv connection current | wv connection set <name> --host <host> --user <user> --active
codes.title: No active connection profile
codes.verification: wv connection current returns selected profile with host and user.

codes.description: A selected profile exists but declares a capability version not supported by the current wv binary.
codes.developer_action: Keep capability migrations monotonic and add compatibility tests for each profile version.
kb_titles: Connection profile is missing or inactive
codes.operator_action: Run wv connection capabilities and upgrade/downgrade explicitly after reviewing loss flags.
codes.related_commands: wv connection capabilities | wv connection upgrade <name> --to <version>
codes.title: Connection capability version mismatch
codes.verification: Capability list reports supported version and selected profile version.

codes.description: A required local runtime or build dependency is unavailable.
codes.developer_action: Ensure dependency plan names the missing command and does not silently fallback to Python-only setup.
kb_titles: Dependency setup and native tool availability
codes.operator_action: Run wv deps plan/status and install missing tools with home method or explicit package-manager mode.
codes.related_commands: wv deps status --include-build --json | wv deps install --dry-run
codes.title: Required dependency is missing
codes.verification: wv deps status reports installed or known acceptable missing optional dependency.

codes.description: Dependency installation requires package-manager privileges or force confirmation that was not granted.
codes.developer_action: Keep privileged paths explicit and audit logged.
kb_titles: Dependency setup and native tool availability
codes.operator_action: Use home method, or rerun with explicit --method package-manager --manager NAME after reviewing plan.
codes.title: Package-manager operation denied
codes.verification: Dependency log contains denied action and no package-manager mutation occurred.

codes.description: Filesystem mount was requested but FUSE support is unavailable on this host.
codes.developer_action: Report FUSE readiness separately from VFS endpoint readiness.
kb_titles: 9P/VFS or FUSE mount is unavailable
codes.operator_action: Install macFUSE/libfuse where supported or use wv ls/cp instead of mounting.
codes.title: FUSE or macFUSE unavailable
codes.verification: wv status shows FUSE ready or workflow uses non-FUSE VFS command.

codes.description: MCP support is configured but the listener is not alive or not exposing expected tools.
codes.developer_action: Status must distinguish configured, running, port open, and tool availability.
kb_titles: MCP listener is configured but not running
codes.operator_action: Start MCP service or update config; use logs before reporting ready.
codes.title: MCP listener down
codes.verification: MCP status reports alive=true and tool list includes expected namespace.

codes.description: A release artifact does not match its checksum/signature/provenance metadata.
codes.developer_action: Make verification failure explicit and include artifact/sidecar paths.
kb_titles: Release artifact verification failed
codes.operator_action: Do not install; reacquire or rebuild artifact and verify again.
codes.title: Artifact checksum or signature mismatch
codes.verification: verify script passes checksum/signature/smoke.

codes.description: Homebrew Formula generation could not use the provided archive.
codes.developer_action: Keep formula generator validating target/version/sha256 before writing Formula.
kb_titles: Homebrew or Snap packaging support failed
codes.operator_action: Generate binary-dist for darwin/linux and rerun homebrew-formula with correct archive/URL base.
codes.title: Homebrew Formula archive invalid
codes.verification: homebrew-formula-plan returns artifact with url and sha256.

codes.description: Snap project generation is available, but building .snap requires snapcraft on Linux.
codes.developer_action: Keep plan/project generation independent from snapcraft availability.
kb_titles: Homebrew or Snap packaging support failed
codes.operator_action: Run package-snap-project for review or build .snap on a Linux host with snapcraft installed.
codes.related_commands: make package-snap-plan | make package-snap-project | make package-snap
codes.title: Snapcraft unavailable for package build
codes.verification: package-snap-project writes snap/snapcraft.yaml and payload/bin/wv.

codes.description: One side of a bidirectional relay exited before clean drain/close.
codes.developer_action: Capture close reason, bytes in/out, pump state, and cleanup path.
kb_titles: Relay, bridge, or socket policy rejected unsafe binding
codes.operator_action: Check both endpoint logs, retry after confirming target service is healthy.
codes.title: Relay pump terminated early
codes.verification: Both pumps exit, counters are final, no active relay is reaped by cleanup.

codes.description: A relay, bridge, or adapter tried to bind a public/non-loopback address without explicit policy.
codes.developer_action: Keep bind policy centralized and audit all overrides.
kb_titles: Relay, bridge, or socket policy rejected unsafe binding
codes.operator_action: Use 127.0.0.1/::1 or generate a dataplane policy with explicit non-loopback allowance.
codes.title: Unsafe non-loopback bind rejected
codes.verification: Plan shows loopback bind or explicit reviewed override.

codes.description: A socket bridge such as socat/ncat was rejected by loopback, endpoint, or lifecycle policy.
codes.developer_action: Planner should emit exact command, PID/log paths, and policy decision before execution.
kb_titles: External tool adapter attempted to replace weaverssh data plane
Relay, bridge, or socket policy rejected unsafe binding
codes.operator_action: Use loopback bind and managed lifecycle; review dataplane policy for any exception.
codes.title: Socket bridge command rejected
codes.verification: Bridge plan is loopback-only, audited, and terminates at approved endpoint.

codes.description: SSH authentication or host connection failed for a profile or chain hop.
codes.developer_action: Surface failing hop and exact adapter/provider used with secrets redacted.
kb_titles: SSH login or chain authentication failed
codes.operator_action: Test raw ssh with the same user/host, load key, fix profile, then retry.
codes.title: SSH login failed
codes.verification: Raw ssh login succeeds and wv chain probe passes.

codes.description: A workflow requested forwarded identity support but no usable agent/forwarding path was available.
codes.developer_action: Keep agent forwarding optional unless profile requires it and report provider detection details.
kb_titles: SSH login or chain authentication failed
codes.operator_action: Start/load identity provider or switch to explicit identity file/profile.
codes.title: Agent forwarding unavailable
codes.verification: ssh-add -l works locally and requested chain reports agent availability.

codes.description: A destructive validation workflow was requested without explicit approval.
codes.developer_action: Keep validation harnesses outside product trigger and require gate checks.
kb_titles: Release artifact verification failed
codes.operator_action: Rerun only after selecting disposable nodes and passing the destructive gate.
codes.title: Destructive validation gate missing
codes.verification: Validation command includes --allow-destructive and target nodes are disposable.

codes.description: The 9P/VFS service is not running or not reachable.
codes.developer_action: Keep 9P plugin discovery accurate and avoid reporting available when artifacts are missing.
kb_titles: 9P/VFS or FUSE mount is unavailable
codes.operator_action: Run plugin discovery/status, start 9P service, verify listener and root path.
codes.title: 9P VFS endpoint unavailable
codes.verification: vfs.9p plugin available and status reports listener/root.

codes.description: The connection passed X11 setup but failed the required WebSocket upgrade/framing phase.
codes.developer_action: Keep downgrade attempts rejected and add frame parser test for the observed case.
kb_titles: WebSocket second phase failed or downgraded
codes.operator_action: Inspect upgrade/frame logs and retry with correct wv endpoints.
codes.title: WebSocket second phase rejected
codes.verification: Trace shows X11 setup success followed by valid WebSocket phase.

codes.description: The X11 DISPLAY value could not be mapped to a supported Unix or TCP endpoint.
codes.developer_action: Parser should report display family, display number, screen, and candidate sockets.
kb_titles: DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY resolution failed
codes.operator_action: Start X server, export DISPLAY, verify endpoint, then retry.
codes.title: DISPLAY could not be resolved
codes.verification: DISPLAY maps to existing /tmp/.X11-unix/XN or localhost:6000+N listener.

codes.description: The selected X11 endpoint has no matching MIT-MAGIC-COOKIE-1 authority row.
codes.developer_action: Do not relay until cookie lookup and setup authorization succeed.
kb_titles: DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY resolution failed
codes.operator_action: Fix XAUTHORITY, regenerate xauth, or choose the endpoint matching the authority key.
codes.title: XAUTHORITY cookie missing or mismatched
codes.verification: xauth list includes display-keyed cookie matching selected socket.

codes.description: X11 setup validation failed and the connection correctly did not enter relay mode.
codes.developer_action: Keep tests proving failed setup never tunnels.
kb_titles: X11 setup was rejected before relay
codes.operator_action: Correct X11 setup/auth inputs; do not override fail-closed behavior.
codes.title: X11 setup failed closed
codes.verification: Trace shows setup rejected and relay inactive.
